titleZh: 听力基础训练（合成语音草稿）
author: 内置生成器草稿

sources.title: 本工具生成的基础练习
sources.rightsNote: 由项目内置生成器编写的原创练习句与题目，非真题转载；逐题独立审核进行中。

paragraphs.text: Attention please. The number seven bus has changed its route this month. It now stops at the north gate instead of the main gate. Plan five extra minutes for your morning trip.

resources.transcript: Attention please. The number seven bus has changed its route this month. It now stops at the north gate instead of the main gate. Plan five extra minutes for your morning trip.

paragraphs.text: The computer room reopens today after repairs. Please save your work every ten minutes, and do not install any software without permission from the teacher on duty.

resources.transcript: The computer room reopens today after repairs. Please save your work every ten minutes, and do not install any software without permission from the teacher on duty.

paragraphs.text: Our cooking class this week teaches a simple vegetable soup. Ingredients are provided. Students with food allergies must tell the teacher before Thursday so we can prepare a safe alternative.

resources.transcript: Our cooking class this week teaches a simple vegetable soup. Ingredients are provided. Students with food allergies must tell the teacher before Thursday so we can prepare a safe alternative.

paragraphs.text: Next week is exam week. The study hall will stay open until ten, and quiet rules apply all day. Phones must be switched off and placed in the front basket during each session.

resources.transcript: Next week is exam week. The study hall will stay open until ten, and quiet rules apply all day. Phones must be switched off and placed in the front basket during each session.

paragraphs.text: Our partner school in Australia will send ten students next month. Each visiting student needs a local buddy. If you want to be a buddy, write a short self-introduction and hand it in by Friday.

resources.transcript: Our partner school in Australia will send ten students next month. Each visiting student needs a local buddy. If you want to be a buddy, write a short self-introduction and hand it in by Friday.

paragraphs.text: A good way to remember new words is to use them the same day. Write one short sentence for each word tonight. Ten minutes of practice beats two hours of silent reading.

resources.transcript: A good way to remember new words is to use them the same day. Write one short sentence for each word tonight. Ten minutes of practice beats two hours of silent reading.

paragraphs.text: Dear students, our career office offers practice interviews this Friday. Bring a printed copy of your resume. Each session lasts twenty minutes, and sign-up closes on Wednesday evening.

resources.transcript: Dear students, our career office offers practice interviews this Friday. Bring a printed copy of your resume. Each session lasts twenty minutes, and sign-up closes on Wednesday evening.

paragraphs.text: Before entering the science lab, you must wear safety glasses at all times. Do not taste any material, and report every accident to your teacher immediately, however small it seems.

resources.transcript: Before entering the science lab, you must wear safety glasses at all times. Do not taste any material, and report every accident to your teacher immediately, however small it seems.

paragraphs.text: The school library will close at nine tonight. Please return your books before leaving. Students who keep books longer than two weeks will receive a reminder by email.

resources.transcript: The school library will close at nine tonight. Please return your books before leaving. Students who keep books longer than two weeks will receive a reminder by email.

paragraphs.text: A green schoolbag was found in the reading room yesterday. It contains two textbooks and a water bottle. The owner may collect it at the lost-and-found desk before four o'clock.

resources.transcript: A green schoolbag was found in the reading room yesterday. It contains two textbooks and a water bottle. The owner may collect it at the lost-and-found desk before four o'clock.

paragraphs.text: This Saturday the history club visits the city museum. We meet at the school gate at eight forty. Bring your student card, and do not touch the ancient tools on the second floor.

resources.transcript: This Saturday the history club visits the city museum. We meet at the school gate at eight forty. Bring your student card, and do not touch the ancient tools on the second floor.

paragraphs.text: The music club needs a piano player for the New Year show. Practice takes place every Tuesday after class. If you can play one complete piece, please leave your name at the club door.

resources.transcript: The music club needs a piano player for the New Year show. Practice takes place every Tuesday after class. If you can play one complete piece, please leave your name at the club door.

paragraphs.text: The photo show on the third floor collects pictures of daily school life. Twenty works will be chosen for the wall. Hand in your photo with your name on the back by next Tuesday.

resources.transcript: The photo show on the third floor collects pictures of daily school life. Twenty works will be chosen for the wall. Hand in your photo with your name on the back by next Tuesday.

paragraphs.text: Because of heavy rain, today's sports meeting moves to next Monday. Class schedules stay unchanged. Athletes should keep their equipment at home until the new date.

resources.transcript: Because of heavy rain, today's sports meeting moves to next Monday. Class schedules stay unchanged. Athletes should keep their equipment at home until the new date.

paragraphs.text: This term's reading plan starts with short stories. Read one story each week and mark two sentences you like. We will discuss your choices in small groups every Friday.

resources.transcript: This term's reading plan starts with short stories. Read one story each week and mark two sentences you like. We will discuss your choices in small groups every Friday.

paragraphs.text: Research shows that sleep helps memory. Students who sleep seven hours or more recall vocabulary better than those who study all night. Plan your review, then close the book early.

resources.transcript: Research shows that sleep helps memory. Students who sleep seven hours or more recall vocabulary better than those who study all night. Plan your review, then close the book early.

paragraphs.text: The English speech contest final takes place this Friday afternoon. Six speakers will each talk for three minutes. Audience members should stay seated until all speakers finish.

resources.transcript: The English speech contest final takes place this Friday afternoon. Six speakers will each talk for three minutes. Audience members should stay seated until all speakers finish.

paragraphs.text: The morning train to the science camp is delayed by thirty minutes. Please stay in the waiting hall. Our group leader in the red jacket will gather everyone before boarding.

resources.transcript: The morning train to the science camp is delayed by thirty minutes. Please stay in the waiting hall. Our group leader in the red jacket will gather everyone before boarding.

paragraphs.text: Saturday is volunteer day. We will clean the riverside path and plant twenty young trees. Wear old clothes and strong shoes. Gloves and tools will be provided at the meeting point.

resources.transcript: Saturday is volunteer day. We will clean the riverside path and plant twenty young trees. Wear old clothes and strong shoes. Gloves and tools will be provided at the meeting point.

paragraphs.text: A cold wave arrives tonight. Temperatures will drop below zero. Cover the plants on the balcony, dress in warm layers, and allow extra time on icy roads tomorrow morning.

resources.transcript: A cold wave arrives tonight. Temperatures will drop below zero. Cover the plants on the balcony, dress in warm layers, and allow extra time on icy roads tomorrow morning.
